# The PostgreSQL lane's selection (docs/checks.md#what-ci-actually-runs): one test file or
# node id per line. A listed file runs whole, so it holds no SQLite-only test; a file that
# also has SQLite-only tests contributes its PostgreSQL nodes by id. A push to main runs
# every entry; a pull request runs the entries its changed paths reach
# (scripts/postgres_selection.py).
